messages.text:
Subject: Michigan alum + your design review post

Hi Maya,

Your post about how your team runs design reviews hit home. I used the same approach to rebuild our payments API.

I'm a fellow Michigan alum and I'm applying for the Software Engineer role on your team.

Would you be open to a 20 minute coffee chat next week?

Jordan

Hi Maya,

Floating this back up in case it got buried. The payments API rebuild cut p99 latency 38%, and the design review format from your post is a big part of why it shipped clean.

If a 20 minute chat about the Software Engineer role is not possible right now, no worries at all.

Jordan
Love that you rebuilt payments that way. Happy to grab a coffee, does Thursday at 10 work?

Hi Maya,

Thursday at 10 works great, thank you. I will send a calendar invite with a video link so it is easy to find.

Looking forward to it,
Jordan
Hi Maya, fellow Michigan alum and backend engineer. Would love to connect.
